AC amendment (gap analysis): Specify baseline fixture format AND MAX_CYCLES precedence semantics: (a) baseline schema is one expected token per line in dispatch order, plus expected final-state token; (b) MAX_CYCLES precedence: --max-cycles flag > planning.max_remediation_cycles config > built-in default 3; (c) exit codes: 0=conformant, 1=cycle-count violation, 2=upstream-enum violation, 3=protocol-error transition, 4=oscillation violation, 5=min-cycles-rejected. Add fixture cases asserting: flag-only invocation, config-only, flag overrides config, flag<2 rejected even when config>=2, config<2 rejected at load before harness runs.
Verify: bash tests/unit/shared/test-protocol-conformance-harness.sh
